command:
set -eu
install -d -m 0700 /var/backups/inventory
cat > /usr/local/sbin/backup-inventory <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
umask 077
backup_dir=/var/backups/inventory
stamp=$(/usr/bin/date +%F)
archive="$backup_dir/inventory-$stamp.tar.gz"
temporary="$archive.tmp.$$"
trap 'rm -f "$temporary"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
/usr/bin/ssh \
  -o BatchMode=yes \
  -o ConnectTimeout=15 \
  -o IdentitiesOnly=yes \
  -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \
  -o UserKnownHostsFile=/root/.ssh/inventory_backup_known_hosts \
  -i /root/.ssh/inventory_backup_ed25519 \
  root@node2 > "$temporary"
/usr/bin/tar -tzf "$temporary" >/dev/null
/bin/mv -f "$temporary" "$archive"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
/usr/bin/find "$backup_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'inventory-????-??-??.tar.gz' -mtime +6 -delete
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0750 /usr/local/sbin/backup-inventory
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-backup.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Back up node2 inventory data to node1
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/backup-inventory
User=root
Group=root
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectHome=read-only
ProtectSystem=strict
ReadWritePaths=/var/backups/inventory
ANTRIEB_EOF
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-backup.timer <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Nightly inventory backup from node2

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 02:15:00
Persistent=true
RandomizedDelaySec=15m
Unit=inventory-backup.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
restorecon -F /usr/local/sbin/backup-inventory /var/backups/inventory /etc/systemd/system/inventory-backup.service /etc/systemd/system/inventory-backup.timer >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now inventory-backup.timer
printf 'UNIT_VERIFY\n'; systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/inventory-backup.service /etc/systemd/system/inventory-backup.timer
printf 'TIMER_ENABLED='; systemctl is-enabled inventory-backup.timer
printf 'TIMER_ACTIVE='; systemctl is-active inventory-backup.timer
systemctl list-timers inventory-backup.timer --all --no-pager
